sections.text:
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, to be performed 
 every 8000 equivalent operating hours EOH 8000 as indicated in the title block

The gas turbine uses air as working fluid which is drown in and compressed by 
 the compressor, fuel is added and burnt in the combustion chamber to heat the 
 air to turbine inlet temperature, the hot gases is expanded in the turbine.

The exhaust gases leaves the turbine through the exhaust diffuser for being 
 discharged into the stack or to the heat recovery steam generator in the case 
 of combined cycle power plant, the useful output is available at the 
 compressor end coupling to drive the generator.

The first draft initiated by eng. 
Gamal EL-Sayed Xaater, 
tested by eng. Omar EL-Shenety, revised by eng. 
Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and quality control general 
director & MPIS coordinator, accepted by eng. Mohammed Anan general director, 
and approved by eng. Mohmed El-Sarrag: head sector of Damietta CCPS.

This document is accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil: 
EDEPC inspection and quality control general director & MPIS 
coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman; EDEPC 
Planning & financial prediction head sector and supervisor of 
inspection and quality control head 
sector.

items: A work permit must be issued,
The maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmets, shoes, gloves, earplug ... etc
Turbine must be shut down
Complete maintenance set.
Special scaffold.
Compressed air hose.
Cleaning articles [fluid, rags ---- etc].
Steel meter, filler and venire caliper.
24 Vdc electric light.
Penetration test.
Open intake casing door.
Check intake casing for dirt accumulation [oil, dust].
Check blade cleaning device for cracks

Check compressor stage 0 stator blades for dirt accumulation, impact of 
 foreign bodies, corrosion, coating wear and cracks.

Check compressor stage 1 rotor blades for impact of foreign bodies, corrosion, 
 coating wear and cracks.
Check radial gap for compressor stage 1 rotor blades and record in MRDS.
Close intake casing door.

items: Open combustion chamber manhole cover.
Installation special scaffold.
Check dual-fuel burner for dirt accumulation, corrosion and cracks.

Check flame tube plate for dirt accumulation, corrosion, deformation and 
 crack.

Check flame tube with refractory bricks for corrosion, cracks, damage and 
 looseness.
Check over lap between flame tube and mixing chamber for crakes and grooves.
Check radial gap between flame tube and mixing chamber.
Check mixing chamber for cracks.
Check overlap between mixing chamber and inner casing for wear and grooves.
Check radial gap between mixing chamber and inner casing.
Check inner casing for corrosion.

Check gap circumference between inner casing and first stage turbine stator 
 blades.

Check stage 1 turbine stator blades for impact of foreign bodies, corrosion 
 and cracks.
Check radial gap for stage 1 turbine rotor blades.
Close combustion chamber manhole cover.
Open manhole cover at exhaust gas duct.
Check radial blade clearances for turbine stage 4 rotor blades.
Check exhaust gas duct for cracks and dirt accumulation.
Close manhole cover at exhaust gas duct.
Return work order.
Arrangement with operation department to make compressor wash.

Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, to be performed 
 every 8000 equivalent operating hours EOH 8000 as indicated in the title block
The gas turbine uses air as working fluid which is drown in and compressed by 
 the compressor, fuel is added and burnt in the combustion chamber to heat the 
 air to turbine inlet temperature, the hot gases is expanded in the turbine.
The exhaust gases leaves the turbine through the exhaust diffuser for being 
 discharged into the stack or to the heat recovery steam generator in the case 
 of combined cycle power plant, the useful output is available at the 
 compressor end coupling to drive the generator.
